text: This solution, Waipaoa Flood Control Climate Change Resilience Project (WFCS Upgrade) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in New Zealand between Gisborne District Council, Government of New Zealand, KiwiRail, and Earthwork Solutions Ltd. The program was implemented in 2019 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
